question: Q-W-S2-D3
text: Compare ordered quantity by selling package by calendar quarter, 2014 vs 2015.
interpretation: Ordered quantity by selling package (as-was stock item attribute) by calendar quarter, 2014 vs 2015.
assemble: SELECT selling_package, calendar_quarter, MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2014 THEN ordered_quantity END) AS ordered_quantity_2014, MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2015 THEN ordered_quantity END) AS ordered_quantity_2015, CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2015 THEN ordered_quantity END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2014 THEN ordered_quantity END) AS DOUBLE), 0) - 1 AS change_pct FROM q WHERE order_lines > 0 GROUP BY selling_package, calendar_quarter ORDER BY selling_package, calendar_quarter
